verdict.rationale: Gusto's official MCP server documentation explicitly describes an OAuth2-based connection flow that lets a user 'select the categories of data to which your chosen LLM will have access,' i.e., scoped/least-privilege agent credentials, complementing the API's general system access token model for application-level auth. This directly matches the story of issuing scoped credentials for an AI agent to access Gusto data.  Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the scoping granularity, and more detailed docs on token expiration/revocation or fine-grained scope lists beyond 'categories of data.'
